$comment: Job DQ (DPDP): the companies that process personal data for Stack19, as data. The country is where the service processes or stores the data. First draft: the owner checks each line against the provider's current terms (docs/runbooks/dpdp-owner-checklist.md).

subprocessors.name: Google Cloud
subprocessors.purpose: Runs the app, its background worker and the files you upload
subprocessors.data: Everything the app holds for your business

subprocessors.name: Supabase
subprocessors.data: Your account, your business records and your customers' records

subprocessors.name: Resend
subprocessors.purpose: Sends the e-mails the app sends to you (sign-in links, reminders)
subprocessors.data: Your e-mail address, your name and the text of the e-mail

subprocessors.name: Zoho
subprocessors.purpose: Company mailboxes (the addresses you write to and hear from)
subprocessors.data: What you write to us by e-mail

subprocessors.name: Anthropic
subprocessors.purpose: The AI that drafts replies and answers questions, when you switch it on, and reads a file you upload in the chat when our own server cannot (a scan or a photo)
subprocessors.data: The words of a question or message and the business facts needed to answer it; the page images of a file you upload for an import, only when our server's own reading found nothing (never for a school); no payment details

subprocessors.name: Meta (WhatsApp, lead ads, and the Connect with Facebook sign-up)
subprocessors.purpose: Delivers WhatsApp messages between your business and your customers, hands us the lead forms of your Facebook and Instagram ads, and signs you in to connect your WhatsApp number
subprocessors.data: Customers' phone numbers and the messages, the answers on your lead forms, and your Facebook sign-in when you connect WhatsApp

subprocessors.name: Sarvam AI
subprocessors.purpose: Speaks and understands Indian languages on calls and voice notes, and writes the assistant's replies on calls, when you switch it on
subprocessors.data: The text to be spoken, a short recording to be understood, and the words of the call so far (to write the reply)

subprocessors.name: Cartesia
subprocessors.purpose: Turns the assistant's written reply into a spoken voice on calls and in voice samples, when you switch it on
subprocessors.data: The text to be spoken (the assistant's reply); never the caller's phone number

subprocessors.name: VoiceLink
subprocessors.purpose: Carries our phone calls: answers calls to your business number and places call-backs to people who enquired
subprocessors.data: The phone number of the caller and of your business, the call's audio while it lasts and how long it lasted; Stack19 keeps no recording and VoiceLink's own recording is off
